title: NRiched Cheese Bean Sprout Pilaf
description: A savory and comforting vegetarian dish that combines the flavors of cheese with steamed bean sprouts for a perfect sick-day meal in a donabe vessel.
instructions: Chop the onion and garlic finely.
Blend cheese into a smooth paste with soy sauce until creamy.
Heat oil in donabe, add onions and garlic for a few minutes, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add blended cheese mixture and stir well. Let it cook for about 10 minutes or until cheese melts completely.
Add bean sprouts and wheat bran (for steaming).
Cover the donabe with its lid and steam for about 25 minutes, shaking occasionally to ensure even cooking.
Serve hot as a side dish or main course.
